071        public void advance(float amount) {
072                if (isEnded()) return;
073                
074                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
075                if (isEnding()) {
076                        endingTimeRemaining -= days;
077                        if (endingTimeRemaining <= 0) {
078                                ended = true;
079                                notifyEnded();
080                        }
081                        return;
082                }
083                
084                advanceImpl(amount);
085        }

107        public void endAfterDelay(float days) {
108                endingTimeRemaining = days;
109                boolean wasEnding = isEnding();
110                ending = true;
111                if (!wasEnding) {
112                        notifyEnding();
113                }
114                if (endingTimeRemaining <= 0) {
115                        ended = true;
116                        notifyEnded();
117                }
118        }

283                Set<String> tags = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
284                if (isImportant()) {
285                        tags.add(Tags.INTEL_IMPORTANT);
286                }
287                if (isNew()) {
288                        tags.add(Tags.INTEL_NEW);
289                }
290                if (map != null) {
291                        SectorEntityToken loc = getMapLocation(map);
292                        if (loc != null) {
293                                float max = Global.getSettings().getFloat("maxRelayRangeInHyperspace");
294                                float dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(loc.getLocationInHyperspace(), Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocationInHyperspace());
295                                if (dist <= max) {
296                                        tags.add(Tags.INTEL_LOCAL);
297                                }
298                        }
299                }
300                
301//              FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
302//              if (faction != null && !faction.isPlayerFaction()) {
303//                      if (faction.isHostileTo(Factions.PLAYER)) {
304//                              tags.add(Tags.INTEL_HOSTILE);
305//                      } else {
306//                              tags.add(Tags.INTEL_NOT_HOSTILE);
307//                      }
308//              }
309                
310                return tags;
311        }

480        public boolean canMakeVisibleToPlayer(boolean playerInRelayRange) {
481                return canMakeVisible(playerInRelayRange, 
482                                                                          Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getContainingLocation(),
483                                                                          Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocationInHyperspace(), false);
484        }
485        
486        public boolean canMakeVisibleToCommSniffer(boolean playerInRelayRange, SectorEntityToken relay) {
487                return canMakeVisible(playerInRelayRange, relay.getContainingLocation(), 
488                                                          relay.getLocationInHyperspace(), true);
489        }
490        
491        public boolean canMakeVisible(boolean playerInRelayRange, LocationAPI conLoc, Vector2f hyperLoc,
492                                                                                  boolean commSniffer) {
493                if (isEnding()) return false;
494                
495                if (postingLocation != null) {
496                        float rangeLY = 0f;
497                        if (postingRangeLY != null) {
498                                rangeLY = postingRangeLY;
499                        } else { // unless a range of 0 is specified, get local messages when nearing system
500                                rangeLY = getCommRelayRange();
501                        }
502                        
503                        float commRange = 0f;
504                        if (postingLocation.isInHyperspace()) {
505                                commRange = getCommRelayRange();
506                                rangeLY = Math.max(rangeLY, commRange);
507                        }
508
509                        boolean sameLoc = postingLocation.getContainingLocation() != null &&
510                                                          postingLocation.getContainingLocation() == 
511                                                                conLoc;
512                        if (rangeLY <= 0 && !sameLoc) {
513                                return false;
514                        }
515                        
516                        if (playerInRelayRange) {
517                                float dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(postingLocation.getLocationInHyperspace(), 
518                                                                                                hyperLoc);
519                                return dist <= rangeLY;
520                        } else {
521                                if (postingLocation.isInHyperspace()) {
522                                        float dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(postingLocation.getLocationInHyperspace(), 
523                                                                                                        hyperLoc);
524                                        return dist < commRange && (!commSniffer || playerInRelayRange);
525                                } else {
526                                        return sameLoc && (!commSniffer || playerInRelayRange);
527                                }
528                        }
529                }
530                
531                return playerInRelayRange;
532        }

590        }

593        }
594        protected void addDays(TooltipMakerAPI info, String after, float days, Color c, float pad) {
595                addDays(info, "", after, days, c, pad);
596        }
597        protected void addDays(TooltipMakerAPI info, String before, String after, float days, Color c, float pad) {
598                String pre = "";
599                if (info.getBulletedListPrefix() != null) {
600                        pre = "";
601                }
602                
603                int d = (int) Math.round(days);
604                String daysStr = "days";
605                if (d <= 1) {
606                        d = 1;
607                        daysStr = "day";
608                }
609                if (c == null) c = Misc.getGrayColor();
610                if (after != null && !after.isBlank()) after = " " + after;
611                info.addPara(before + pre + "%s " + daysStr + after, pad, c,
612                                Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + d);
613        }

734        public static void addMarketToList(TooltipMakerAPI info, MarketAPI market, float pad, Color tc) {
735                if (tc == null) tc = Misc.getTextColor();
736                String indent = BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT;
737                if (info.getBulletedListPrefix() != null) indent = "";
738                LabelAPI label = info.addPara(indent + market.getName() + " (size %s, %s)",
739                                //faction.getPersonNamePrefixAOrAn() + " %s colony.", 
740                                pad, tc, market.getFaction().getBaseUIColor(),
741                                "" + (int) market.getSize(),
742                                market.getFaction().getDisplayName());
743

780        public void addLogTimestamp(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float opad) {
781                
782//              if (!getTagsForSort().contains(Tags.INTEL_FLEET_LOG) && !getTagsForSort().contains(Tags.INTEL_EXPLORATION)) {
783                if (!getTagsForSort().contains(Tags.INTEL_FLEET_LOG) && 
784                                !getTagsForSort().contains(Tags.INTEL_MARKER)) {
785                        return;
786                }
787                
788//              {
789//                      float days = getDaysSincePlayerVisible();
790//                      if (days >= 1) {
791//                              addDays(info, "Log entry added ", "ago.", days, tc, opad);
792//                      } else {
793//                              info.addPara("Log entry added less than a day ago.", opad);
794//                      }
795//              }
796                
797                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
798                
799                long ts = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();
800                if (timestamp != null) ts = timestamp;
801                CampaignClockAPI clock = Global.getSector().getClock().createClock(ts);
802                
803//              String dateStr = "Logged on c." + clock.getCycle() + ", " + clock.getShortMonthString() + " " + clock.getDay();
804//              //tc = Misc.getGrayColor();
805//              info.addPara(dateStr, opad, tc, h, "c." + clock.getCycle(), "" + clock.getDay());
806                
807                long msPerMin = 60L * 1000L;
808                long msPerHour = msPerMin * 60L;
809                long msPerDay = msPerHour * 24L;
810                //long msPerWeek = msPerDay * 7L;
811                long msPerMonth = msPerDay * 30L;
812                long msPerCycle = msPerDay * 365L;
813
814                long diff = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp() - ts;
815
816
817                String agoStr = "";
818                List<String> highlights = new ArrayList<>();
819//              highlights.add("c." + clock.getCycle());
820//              highlights.add("" + clock.getDay());
821                if (diff < msPerHour && false) {
822                        long minutes = diff / msPerMin;
823                        agoStr = "" + minutes + " " + (minutes == 1 ? "minute" : "minutes");
824                } else if (diff < msPerDay && false) {
825                        long hours = diff / msPerHour;
826                        agoStr = "" + hours + " " + (hours == 1 ? "hour" : "hours");
827                        long rem = diff - hours * msPerHour;
828                        long minutes = rem / msPerMin;
829                        agoStr += " " + minutes + " " + (minutes == 1 ? "minute" : "minutes");
830                } else if (diff < msPerMonth) {
831                        long days = diff / msPerDay;
832                        agoStr = "" + days + " " + (days == 1 ? "day" : "days");
833                        highlights.add("" + days);
834//                      long rem = diff - days * msPerDay;
835//                      long hours = rem / msPerHour;
836//                      agoStr += " " + hours + " " + (hours == 1 ? "hour" : "hours");
837                } else if (diff < msPerCycle) {
838                        long months = diff / msPerMonth;
839                        agoStr = "" + months + " " + (months == 1 ? "month" : "months");
840                        long rem = diff - months * msPerMonth;
841                        long days = rem / msPerDay;
842                        agoStr += " and " + days + " " + (days == 1 ? "day" : "days");
843                        highlights.add("" + months);
844                        highlights.add("" + days);
845                } else {
846                        long cycles = diff / msPerCycle;
847                        agoStr = "" + cycles + " " + (cycles == 1 ? "cycle" : "cycles");
848                        long rem = diff - cycles * msPerCycle;
849                        long months = rem / msPerMonth;
850                        agoStr += " and " + months + " " + (months == 1 ? "month" : "months");
851                        highlights.add("" + cycles);
852                        highlights.add("" + months);
853                }
854                
855
856                //String dateStr = "Logged on c." + clock.getCycle() + ", " + clock.getShortMonthString() + " " + clock.getDay();
857                //tc = Misc.getGrayColor();
858                //info.addPara(dateStr + ", " + agoStr + " ago.", opad, tc, h, highlights.toArray(new String[0]));
859                long days = diff / msPerDay;
860                if (days >= 1) {
861                        info.addPara("Log entry added " + agoStr + " ago.", opad, tc, h, highlights.toArray(new String[0]));
862                } else {
863                        info.addPara("Log entry added less than a day ago.", opad);
864                }
865                
866                //ago = Label.create(agoStr, Misc.getGrayColor());
867        }
